notes: נְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר is split, not fused: the ASV spends *saith* on the construct noun and *The man* on the article and its noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet. The article takes the written *The* standing before its own word under rule 29, and the construct דִּבְרֵי takes a supplied one.
The three margins (Jakeh of Massa; burden; the wholly re-read 'I have wearied myself') were read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text is what is aligned.
Both לְ + Ithiel pairs are written twice in Hebrew and twice in English, so rule 22 reaches neither.
